title: Coconut Water Is Just Sugar Water
hook: Coconut water is sold as a natural, healthy way to hydrate. But really, it's sugar water.
body: One of the normal sized cartons is about 90 calories and 20 grams of sugar, and the big 1 liter carton a lot of people drink throughout the day is about 180 calories and 40 grams of sugar. Unless you're running a marathon in the heat, you don't need it, so just drink water, and if you want the electrolytes, put a scoop of a zero-calorie electrolyte powder in your water. I drank large amounts of coconut water for years thinking I needed it to stay hydrated, but these days I stay just as hydrated or better from using a zero-calorie electrolyte powder.
close: Leave a comment to let me know if you've been drinking coconut water to stay hydrated.
